lines.en: I press in on you, step by step.
My boots grind the grass.
I lower my body and stride.
Orange cloth flashes through the shade.
I arc toward you in a circle.
One push of the toes clears the ditch.
My shadow chases along the ground.
I slip sideways between trunks.
The pace is unhurried but never stops.
I snap the branch underfoot.
I approach from a new angle.
Fists low, ready to lift.
I stand and let my ki build.
I slowly close my fist.
I stare at one point without moving.
My chest rises heavily.
I roll my wrists.
The wind lifts my hem.
I lower my head as if listening.
The muscles in my shoulders stay tight.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，是照着别人做的。
lines.en: This face was copied from someone else.
I neither speak nor leave.
I grind my foot in place.
I open my palm and close it.
I have not blinked once.
I am waiting for a gap.
I raise my head and meet your eyes.
You recognise this face, do you not?
I tilt my head.
I am weighing your strength.

lines.zh: 你的站姿到处都是漏洞
lines.en: Your stance is full of holes.
I take half a step forward.
I smile, faintly.
No need to speak. I understand.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛和你的一模一样
lines.en: My eyes are just like yours.
I raise a hand and lower it.
You are afraid already.
This body is stronger than you think.

lines.zh: 克隆的脖子，比原版更脆。
lines.en: The clone's neck is frailer than the original.
Run as far as you like, I will catch you.
I nod slowly.
We are much alike, really.
Then you strike first.
I sink my centre of gravity.
That one landed clean.
I take the hit and keep grinning.
Blood seeps at the corner of my mouth.
I snatch a short breath.
My arm goes numb a moment.
I grit my teeth and rise.
I will remember that blow.
My gi splits along one seam.
I wipe the blood away.
I am still standing.
You think I would eat that?
I glance once and look away.
Such things cannot buy me.
I sweep it aside with my hand.
What is it you want?
I am not hungry at all.
Keep it for yourself.
My attention is elsewhere.
That is nowhere near enough.
I shake my head.
You hit me and fall back two steps.
I drop my weight and hold.
Shoulder to shoulder, neither gives.
You slip past my elbow.
I bar you with my arm.
The impact scrapes my boot.
We clash and part.
You have real strength.
I plant my feet and stand straight.
Colliding like this is pointless.
She stands behind me.
We stand back to back.
Her hand rests on my arm.
We look the same way.
She is quieter than I.
We trade a single nod.
Her ki feels like mine.
We crouch together.
She moves first; I follow.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的血，认得出彼此。
lines.en: Saiyan blood recognizes its own.
I bend to pick up a stone.
I crush it to powder.
I pick up a bracer.
I toss it casually.
One look and I discard it.
I tuck it into my gi.
I pick up a snapped branch.
I break it in two.
I pick up a fallen fruit.
I grip it and let go.
I stop holding my ki back.
I have your spot memorised.
I lift my head and lock on.
Ki lifts the soil at my feet.
No courtesies in this fight.
I begin to accelerate.
You are already within one step.
First I cut your path.
This blow will not be light.
I clench my fist.
I hear every breath you take.
I give you no time to prepare.
I press forward.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在动，我看得清
lines.en: I can see your eyes move.
I fix on your wrist.
Now we begin.
One of your steps, one of mine.
You go left; I block left.
I hold you in the corner of my eye.
I move before each of your swings.
One step covers this distance.
Your weight is on your right foot.
I am in no rush to throw it.
I am waiting for you to tire.
Your ki is already ragged.
I stay close and never let go.
This face looks familiar, does it not?
I move, and you back away.
I know your next move.
My breathing is steadier than yours.
You looked away at someone else.
I crowd you into the open.
You will get no chance to breathe.
I am waiting for a clean angle.
This fist lands on your chest.
My knee follows upward.
I kick you away.
The second fist chases your head.
My elbow drops on your shoulder.
I stay close and land three blows.

lines.zh: 你挡下一下，没挡住第二下
lines.en: You block one, not the second.
I push off the ground and catch you.
My fist grazes your ear.

lines.zh: 这一拳，和悟空的一样重。
lines.en: This punch lands as heavy as Goku's.
My knee breaks your guard.
He slams into a tree trunk.
My sweep takes his legs out.
I pull the punch and step back.
I put seven tenths into that one.
He does not get up.
I step from the trees into the open.
The orange hem shows first.
The grass flattens where I land.
I straighten and survey the place.
Someone's ki is loud here.
I walk slowly forward.

lines.zh: 我的影子和你重叠了一下
lines.en: My shadow overlaps yours for a moment.
You should know this face.
I open my fist and close it.
The sounds around us fade.
I glance at the sky first.
Pebbles hop lightly on the ground.
I stand a few steps away.
My ki pushes the dust aside.
I say nothing.
I am already here.
This feels familiar.
I stride in on you.
Fire licks up my arm.
I fall from a height.
Water fills my lungs.
The blast hurls me away.
Something lodges in my shoulder.
Magic presses my ki down.
My strength drains away.
Lightning runs through me.
The ground no longer exists.
